profile.name: Luminos精密滚转轴
profile.description: 这是一种电动精密滚转旋转轴，通常集成在多轴定位或光学对准平台中，用于让样品、光纤夹具或光学元件绕滚转轴进行微小角度调整。它常用于光子器件耦合、显微与光学实验中的精密姿态校准和重复定位。
profile.description_en: This is a motorized precision roll axis typically integrated into a multi-axis positioning or optical alignment stage. It is used to rotate a sample, fiber fixture, or optical component about the roll axis with fine angular control. It is commonly used for photonic device coupling, microscopy, and precision attitude alignment in optical experiments.
